Careers at envoy
Hard is our baseline.
Many tech companies are comfortable. That’s fine. But it’s not us. At Envoy, we embrace the hard stuff. We solve real problems—keeping workplaces safe, compliant, and running smoothly—while sweating the details that shape everyday experiences.
Driven, hardworking, and collaborative people thrive here. If that sounds like you, come build with us.
Watch the videoCheck out the perks
Help design how workplaces run for years to come
Work on products that shape how workplaces operate and how people experience work every single day.
Explore open roles
ENGINEERING, PRODUCT & DESIGN
Trust is in our name—and in everything we ship
To be an “envoy” is to be entrusted with something important. Our customers rely on us to keep their workplaces running, and that responsibility shapes how we build. Here, you’ll take ideas from concept to production, raise the standard, and own the outcome.
Build what you’ll use every day
We design and ship products we rely on ourselves. We’re our own toughest critics, always prioritizing usability, sweating the details, and focusing on solving real problems for our customers.
Raise the bar
We favor clarity, speed, and accountability over comfort. We move fast, learn quickly, and we’re always in service of building something better.
Own the outcome
People, not titles, ship incredible products. We expect ownership at every level and trust teams to take ideas from problem to production.
Built In | 2026 Winning Workplace
Powering great workplaces starts with our own
Built In has recognized Envoy as a Best Place to Work four years in a row. While we don’t chase awards, we’re proud this reflects the ownership, collaboration, and people-first culture our team shows up with every day.
Learn more
“I was attracted to Envoy by the ambition of the company and the impact it’s having, and I was genuinely impressed by how thoughtful and professional the hiring process was. It showed me this is a place that invests in people and gives them room to do their best work.”
Ben Ede
 |  
Engineering Director, Envoy
“At Envoy, I tackle unique engineering challenges with the autonomy to shape entire products that have significant impact across the workplace experience. Join Envoy if you're passionate about transforming complex workplace needs into elegant solutions that enhance how people experience their work environment.”
Josh Scorca
 |  
Senior iOS Engineer, Envoy
“What truly sets Envoy apart is the people, collaborative, driven, and always willing to go the extra mile. We can work with nearly any company, which makes the work both exciting and meaningful. I’ve seen how we help solve critical challenges around physical security and employee experience.”
Sam Cheifetz
 |  
Enterprise AE, Envoy
“From the moment I met the team, I knew Envoy was the place for builders. Solving real-world, complex problems is fun when you’re surrounded by people who care and are just as excited as you are. Shaping the future of the workplace together brings me joy every day.”
Shirley Gao
 |  
Product Manager, Envoy
Great work happens together
That’s why we create intentional moments for collaboration, learning, and inspiration—from prototyping new ideas to sharing feedback and celebrating wins.
Hack Nights
Teams gather to prototype ideas, experiment quickly, and share demos with the broader group.
Envoy Experiences
We put our latest products in front of customers, gather feedback, and learn how Envoy shows up in real workplaces.
Socials
Folks come together to unwind, connect, and strengthen the partnerships that make great product work possible.
Our values
Five core values guide everything we do. These principles keep us intentional, accountable, and unafraid to do the hard work.
Create great experiences
We bring care, curiosity, and craft to everything we do. We aim for great, not good.
Communicate openly
We believe transparency builds trust, and trust makes great teams.
Stand out
We’re not afraid to do things differently or challenge what’s always been done.
Pitch in
We show up for each other and for the work. No ego, no hesitation.
Choose action
We move forward with intention, confidence, and momentum.
‍
Envoy culture
What you'll find from day one
A lively workplace
We’re not remote. We collaborate, problem solve, and ship in person, feeding off each other’s ideas and momentum.
People who raise your bar
You’ll work alongside teammates who are kind, sharp, low-ego, and serious about building something great together.
Products that truly matter
What you build will be used in real workplaces every day, shaping how millions of people experience work around the world.
Pitch  in
We show up for each other and for the work. No ego, no hesitation.
Choose  action
We move forward with intention, confidence, and momentum.
Customers who inspire us
They push us to innovate and share our passion for creating workplaces that truly work for people. Their feedback drives us forward.
Real ownership & growth
You’ll have real responsibility, space to make decisions, and a team that backs you as you learn and grow your career.
Plenty of office pups
Bring your own, or just enjoy the hallway tail wags, occasional meeting cameos, and spontaneous desk-side visits.
Pitch  in
We show up for each other and for the work. No ego, no hesitation.
Choose  action
We move forward with intention, confidence, and momentum.
Communities @ Envoy
We believe people do their best work when they feel seen, supported, and celebrated. Our employee resource groups (Black at Envoy, Women at Envoy, Hola at Envoy, Queers & Allies, and API at Envoy) foster community and growth.
Envoys have also formed dozens of interest groups on Slack. From gardeners and globe-trotters to pet lovers, gamers, bookworms, cooks, musicians, artists, and parents, there’s space for everyone to show up fully and form meaningful connections.
The perks
Full health coverage for you and your dependents
$100 monthly stipend towards your choice of AI programs
Generous commuter benefits for both US and international employees
A 401K, so you can invest in your future
Learning and development stipends
Company-wide recognition program with monthly bonus rewards
Free daily lunch catering, beverages, and snacks
Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office
Flexible time off to help you recharge
12 weeks of paid parental leave
$100 monthly wellness credit
$100 headphone credit every 2 years
How we interview
We want you to feel prepared and supported throughout your interview process. 
Here’s what you can expect:
A transparent, structured process.
We’ll tell you who you’re meeting and why.
Thoughtful conversations.
We focus on curiosity, openness, and alignment with our values, not polished performances.
A chance to show your strengths.
You’ll have opportunities to demonstrate how you work, think, and communicate.
Respect for your time.
We keep the process efficient and keep you updated at every step.
